results.title: Fubei Park
results.overview: The building is gone. After the fire, they planted flowers and trees. The past lies covered, as if no one had ever lived here. There is no stone. No name to speak. The park grew green, but nothing named who once had been.

results.title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
results.original_title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
results.overview: We’re all just floating, waiting for someone to find us.

results.title: Full Moon
results.overview: I love dancing K-POP with my best friend in our club. Though I am the tallest, the spotlight is mine at the center. But things are about to change- my best friend might become my ex-best friend; She's dating my secret crush! People say my mom and dad are a little unusual, but to me, they're just an ordinary family. The neighbor lady seems suspicious-she once filmed SNS videos with her daughter, and now she wants my mom to join instead. I have to stop this somehow. Maybe I should talk to her daughter first...

results.title: Space
results.overview: Ep 1. Jung-ho and So-yeon, a cohabiting couple in their 40s, previously agreed not to have children. However, Jung-ho demands a child, using his mother as an excuse. So-yeon, an unknown actress, feels deeply betrayed, and in that moment, her body turns transparent before his eyes. Ep 2. Pursued by a mysterious floating knife, In-cheol lives with his son, Jin-woo, following a business failure and divorce. Jin-woo abandons his dreams and breaks up with his girlfriend. After they argue and blame each other, Jin-woo leaves home. The knife chasing In-cheol finally locates their house. Ep 3. A year later, Jung-ho struggles with his failing restaurant afloat, while Jin-woo wanders without a home. Jin-woo earns, borrows, and even extracts money from Jung-ho. As they clash, Jung-ho finds it increasingly impossible to understand who Jin-woo truly is.

results.title: A Second Chance Christmas
results.overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

results.title: Things I Left at the Theater
results.overview: Film critic Dogyeong belatedly learns of an old friend's death. As it happens, this comes not long after the demolition of an old theater in Gangwon Province. Somehow, the two events do not feel all that different to her. As her work as a critic takes her from place to place, Dogyeong searches for her late friend’s short film and visits theaters and screening spaces where it might once have been shown.

results.title: Ashes of the Mountain
results.overview: A lone wanderer climbs a snowy mountain, haunted by the ghosts of their past. Set in a surreal space between life and death this charcoal mixed media film follows the journey of a relationship between a father and a daughter.

results.title: Casualty
results.overview: At the outset of Operation Desert Storm, a mortally wounded Kurdish surgeon reflects on his history—both personal and political—as he observes the bombing of Baghdad from a well outside the city.

results.title: Pinch Play
results.overview: Coach Gao strikes a shady deal with rival Coach Ma, throwing the game in exchange for sponsorship. Gao sends in bench player Ku, hoping for a quick out. But Ku's unexpected swing catches the other team off guard, and the young boy's raw passion reminds Gao why he coaches in the first place.

results.title: Loved One
results.overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

results.title: Buff
results.overview: After being released from jail for climate activism, a woman encounters an abused rodeo buffalo for which she will trek the American southwest in an attempt to free it and herself. Starring Jena Malone (The Hunger Games series, The Neon Demon) and Joshua Close (Killers of the Flower Moon, Fargo TV series).

results.title: The Echo of Whales
results.original_title: 那天，我把鯨魚送回大海
results.overview: Eight-year-old Yu-xin lives a colorful yet lonely life by the sea. Convinced her hiccups are a whale's gulps for air, she sends out calls for companions. Through a school vent, she finds one—a silent girl. They share adventures until Yu-xin realizes her friend is hiding something.

results.title: The Unrooted Bloom
results.overview: In a fractured America, a biracial woman journeys between her White conservative roots and her Black ancestral past, confronting the cost of identity in a nation built on division.

results.title: El Camino
results.overview: Young people living in different eras have to overcome obstacles, transform themselves and grow. They demonstrate their resilience, courage and sacrifice. A manifesto about youth and their ability to play a leading role throughout history.

results.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026
results.overview: The 2026 Money in the Bank, also promoted as Money in the Bank: New Orleans, is an upcoming professional wrestling premium live event produced by WWE. It will be the 17th annual Money in the Bank event and will take place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana. This will be the first Money in the Bank to be held in October, making it the latest scheduled Money in the Bank in a calendar year, and the first one to be held after SummerSlam.

results.title: Postmortem
results.overview: Helena, a forensic medical investigator, is overwhelmed by grief after the death of her husband Richard. When she becomes obsessed with a disturbing new case, Helena starts to believe she can bring Richard back — unleashing a cascade of terrifying consequences.

results.title: The Birds
results.overview: Yeok, a middle-aged teacher raising a son and a daughter alone, witnesses students fall to their deaths from the rooftop of the school where she works. Discovering that her daughter Hyejeong was also present at the scene, she presses her for answers, but Hyejeong only repeats the same words: 'There was a bird in the sky.' As the strange, unexplained deaths continue, Yeok, together with a reporter covering the case and a streamer who runs a birding channel, head towards the birds’ habitat.

results.title: Seduction
results.overview: Paulo Martins, a soap opera actor at the peak of his career, believes he has achieved everything he ever wanted: fame, recognition, and money. While filming, he receives news of the death of his father, whom he hasn't seen in 30 years. This event forces him to return to the Amazon rainforest, to the banks of the Tapajós River, where he embarks on a deeply personal journey through memories, reunions, and old wounds that could forever transform his relationship with the past.

results.title: Cosmic Trace
results.overview: Hyeonji, an assistant producer for a YouTube channel, and Jihyeon , a struggling actor, continue living together while grappling with anxieties about the present and the future. When Hyeonji's father dies suddenly and Jihyeon's mother is diagnosed with terminal cancer, they find themselves overwhelmed.

results.title: When the World Will Look at Us
results.overview: A young man with sinister intentions goes to school with a weapon in his pocket. Their world is about to change. He arrives in the worst possible place at the worst possible time, as an overwhelmed teacher and his classroom debate the meaning of democracy.
